semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-temperature sealing materials specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: Shanghai Boilpeak Seals Technology Co., Ltd develops high-temperature perfluoroethers and sealing materials for the semiconductor industry. Their products are engineered to withstand harsh processing environments, enhancing equipment reliability and wafer yield.
capabilities: Custom formulation development for semiconductor applications
Chemical resistance and plasma erosion protection

regional_presence.China: The company operates a manufacturing base of approximately 20,000 square meters, including cleanroom facilities to meet semiconductor process requirements.
